answer.book: Petri Poiret, De eruditione triplici solida, superficiaria et falsa, libri tres (Amsterdam 1692): a three-book work on learning, preceded by front matter (prefatory letters, poems, the table of the frontispiece, a contents list) and followed by the separate treatise Vera methodus inveniendi verum, errata and the Apologetica. The numbered sections inside the books are not itemized here.
